mapper.sql: p.id,p.project_code,p.project_name,p.project_type,p.start_time,p.status,p.description,p.created_at,p.updated_at,(SELECT COUNT(*) FROM req_difference d WHERE d.project_id=p.id AND d.tenant_id=p.tenant_id AND d.deleted=0) difference_count,(SELECT COUNT(*) FROM req_difference d WHERE d.project_id=p.id AND d.tenant_id=p.tenant_id AND d.deleted=0 AND d.review_status='已评审') reviewed_count
mapper.select: SELECT FROM req_project p WHERE p.tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND p.deleted=0 AND (p.project_code LIKE CONCAT('%',#{keyword},'%') OR p.project_name LIKE CONCAT('%',#{keyword},'%')) ORDER BY p.created_at DESC,p.id DESC
SELECT FROM req_project p WHERE p.tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND p.id=#{id} AND p.deleted=0
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM req_project WHERE tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND project_code=#{code} AND deleted=0
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM req_difference WHERE tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND project_id=#{projectId} AND deleted=0
mapper.update: UPDATE req_project project_name=#{p.project_name},project_type=#{p.project_type},start_time=#{p.start_time},status=#{p.status},description=#{p.description},updated_by=#{p.updated_by} WHERE tenant_id=#{p.tenant_id} AND id=#{p.id}
UPDATE req_project SET deleted=1,updated_by=#{operatorId} WHERE tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND id=#{id}
mapper.select: SELECT pm.id,pm.project_id,pm.user_id,pm.member_role,u.username,u.display_name FROM req_project_member pm LEFT JOIN sys_user u ON u.id=pm.user_id AND u.tenant_id=pm.tenant_id WHERE pm.tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND pm.project_id=#{projectId} AND pm.deleted=0 ORDER BY pm.created_at,pm.id
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM sys_user WHERE tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND id=#{userId} AND deleted=0
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM req_project_member WHERE tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND project_id=#{projectId} AND user_id=#{userId} AND deleted=0

SELECT pm.id,pm.project_id,pm.user_id,pm.member_role,u.username,u.display_name FROM req_project_member pm LEFT JOIN sys_user u ON u.id=pm.user_id AND u.tenant_id=pm.tenant_id WHERE pm.tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND pm.id=#{id}
mapper.update: UPDATE req_project_member SET deleted=1 WHERE tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND id=#{id}
